statement: Video gives tips to progress through party dungeons and keep runs consistent; recorded footage only.
Community mostly favors Maestro for attack speed in dungeon with Celtic Ordeal and Coin Toss.
Shaman spams AoE skills (Crazy Concoctions Auspicious Aura); needs at least 60 mana for Auspicious Aura and Sizzling Skull; late-game party dungeons.
Unwise to use Shaman without a lot of base mana.
Wizard good for Tornado and Ice Shards hitting multiple people and slowing them but lacks mana early so use later.
Squire hits multiple with regular attacks and has Shock Wave Slash Whirl and Dagger Ring; highly recommended for newer dungeoneers.
Barbarian hits multiple with regular attacks and has more versatile abilities than Squire like Bear Claw and Axerl hitting enemies above.
Not suggested to use Bowman or Hunter; mostly single target damage and perform worse.
Great Grumblo build is a solid beginner strategy giving 40-60 percent rate depending on level.
Great Grumblo build only works with gray RNG items; picking up a purple item completely nullifies its effect.
Great Grumblo is easily acquired by completing Naked But Unafraid achievement in world 1: kill a poop with nothing equipped.
Stardew Drop gives 50 to 70 percent extra damage.
Stardew Drop only applies with full mana.
Stardew Drop is good with melee-heavy classes; best item for Maestro.
Stardew Drop can be used over Grey Grumblo as you get Horn of the Fool considered one of best RNG items.
Late game strategy: start with Grey Grumblo build then convert to RNG Voucher once unlocked.
RNG Voucher gives a chance to get an RNG item from selling enhancers so you can spam RNG items like Stardew Drop and Horn of the Fool.
RNG Voucher requires rank 10 from red salt refinery which takes a long time.
Dungeon cards are an essential asset; choice depends on what you are looking for.
For more dungeon credits use Chromium Frog card Forlorn Grand Frogger card or Golden Galaxy card.
Chance of getting the Golden Galaxy card is very slim.
Quests can give dungeon card packs which help later.
For dungeon flurbos (base game upgrade currency) use Rotting Grand Frogger and Inevitable Snakestep cards.
If struggling to get cards start with cards buffing card drop chance: Lava Slimer Grumblo and Glaxos cards.
Grand Frogger card gives 15 to 60 percent chance to start with an extra RNG item and can be swapped for another card once in game.
World 3 dungeon guide Wildo has quest for more card packs; do all quests for all party dungeons to get as many packs as possible.
For Wizard or Shaman prioritize MP base damage percent crit chance and drop rarity.
Drop rarity only super useful for world 1 because items must drop to use it.
Barbarian or Maestro need little MP so prioritize base damage and damage percent then drop rarity crit chance then MP.
Want at least about 40 to 60 MP during runs.
MP boosts total MP and MP regen rate useful with Stardew Drop.
Crit chance essential; Horn of the Fool gives only 15 percent flat crit so you need more crit to make it worth it.
Drop rarity increases odds of better weapons armor jewelry and amount of drops; helps a ton for world 1 dungeons.
Drop rarity not a necessity in world 2 or world 3.
Upgrade base damage and damage percent evenly for best results.
Keep other passive stats around half of the really important ones.
Block chance and movement speed are useful in world 2 or world 3.
Upgrade HP if playing with others of higher rank since they will not put you at risk.
Flurbo shop has five star talents including Super Source base efficiency for skills which is really good.
Dungeonic Damage boosts damage based on dungeon credits collected.
Milky Way Candies chance of Time Candy after 30 plus hours; not suggested.
Action Frenzy gives 30 percent more skilling speed at max which is massive for AFK gains.
Mega Crit gives crit chance and extra crit damage past 100 crit chance but you will not really reach that.
Jewelry from flurbo shop not worth it since flurbos go to weapon power AFK gains defense percent and accuracy.
Prefers taking three base damage trait since it scales with damage percent.
Starts each run with two gray RNG items since it stacks later.
Rank 15 trait: each gray RNG item gives plus 1 percent drop chance stacking with the second trait.
Rank 10 trait: dungeon credit drops 30 percent more often from mobs and bosses to upgrade more.
Flurbos only work in base game and do not count toward party dungeons.
Since running RNG Voucher takes enhancer drops from mobs instead of equipment 25 percent more often.
Rank 30 trait: shop prices of RNG items scale up 15 percent slower.
Rank 35 trait: green or better RNG items 25 percent more likely for chance at RNG Voucher or Horn of the Fool.
Maestro main needs less MP so has base damage 75 and damage percent 71 kept about 50 split.
Has about 20 crit chance and will raise it since he runs Horn of the Fool when possible.
Movement speed and block chance are commodity not necessity; no need to prioritize.
Keeps drop rarity at least 61 so world 1 runs consistently reach third frog.
Once passive stats reach about level 40 to 50 upgrade all RNG items to max except Recycler.
Prioritize maxing Stardew Drop and Grey Grumblo as strongest tools when starting.
Without RNG Voucher prioritize Grey Grumblo first.
For consistent god runs max Sugar Rush; Sharp Eye if doing world 1; Rabbit Paw; Rusty Blade; Mana Crystal decent.
Handy Ice Pick is necessity; only three needed for 100 percent double hit (double damage); Boss Skull for extra damage.
Level up weapon if you have excess credits depending on class.
Maestro using Celtic Ordeal does not need weapon leveling; tier three is good standing then upgrade other things since it gets expensive.
If running RNG Voucher build upgrade enhancer drop rate for more items.
With flurbos prioritize non-dungeon stats like weapon power and talent points before books.
Flurbo weapon power gives extra 19.2 weapon power helping characters reach dungeon damage thresholds.
Flurbo talent points give plus 50 each for tab one two three and star talents for total 200 if maxed.
Flurbo AFK gains five percent as you can never have enough.
Flurbo defense percent lets you use less food on rams blood bones etc.
Flurbo accuracy percent useful since world 4 is coming and you need much accuracy.
Accuracy lets you take fewer talent points in tab one and put more into main stat.
Class XP skilling XP and monster cash flurbo upgrades are just commodity for faster upgrading.
